mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resident_judge_application_attachment ( application_id, original_name, content_type, file_size, storage_path, uploader_id ) VALUES ( #{applicationId}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{storagePath}, #{uploaderId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, original_name, content_type, file_size, storage_path, uploader_id, created_at FROM resident_judge_application_attachment WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, application_id, original_name, content_type, file_size, storage_path, uploader_id, created_at FROM resident_judge_application_attachment WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
